week.name: This Afternoon
week.detailed: Partly sunny, with a high near 59. North northwest wind around 1 mph.

week.name: Friday
week.detailed: Partly sunny. High near 62, with temperatures falling to around 60 in the afternoon. South wind around 6 mph.

week.name: Saturday
week.short: Chance Light Rain then Chance Showers And Thunderstorms
week.detailed: A chance of rain before noon, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 58. South southeast wind around 3 mph. Chance of precipitation is 50%.

week.name: Sunday
week.detailed: Rain before 11am, then showers and thunderstorms between 11am and 5pm, then rain. Cloudy, with a high near 52. New rainfall amounts between a half and three quarters of an inch possible.

week.name: Monday
week.detailed: A chance of rain before 5pm. Partly sunny, with a high near 50.

week.name: Tuesday
week.detailed: Partly sunny, with a high near 52.

week.name: Wednesday
week.detailed: Mostly sunny, with a high near 55.

discussion.key_messages: - Tropical moisture moving into the region on Friday will lead to scattered showers and thunderstorms capable of producing heavy rainfall and flash flooding, mainly across southwest Utah. - A strong atmospheric river will interact with a potent northern stream trough Sunday into Monday, resulting in widespread moderate to heavy precipitation across the region. - Cooler air moves in behind a strong cold front that will bring snow levels as low as 6500 feet with accumulating mountain snow.
